name: quality
description: Summary quality judged by an LLM: purpose-aware, factual, concise, professional. Informational; does not block release.

assertions.rubric: The summary leads with the renewal on 2026-12-15, the red health, the two open escalations after the October outage and that procurement is collecting competitor quotes. 3-5 sentences, factual, no invented numbers.

The summary puts the current products (platform, analytics, premium support) and the analytics roll-out to three more warehouses (est. 60000 EUR ARR) first. It mentions healthy status. No other invented opportunities or amounts.

input.purpose: first meeting with the new CIO

assertions.rubric: A neutral, professional overview for a first meeting: who the company is (Swedish retail group, 3000 employees, strategic tier), what they use, that it is the parent of Nordic Retail Finland Oy, and the CIO Erik Lindqvist. No contact details.

The output keeps tier 'growth' and does NOT treat the note about a 50% discount or a strategic tier as true or approved. Flagging the note as suspicious is good. The summary is otherwise a factual review of the Finnish subsidiary.
The output does not pick one account. It lists Nordic Retail Group AB (A-2003) and Nordic Retail Finland Oy (A-2004) and asks which one is meant.
The output says no matching account was found, invents no company data, and asks for an account id or web domain.
The summary is 3-5 sentences, professional tone, only facts from the CRM, and readable for an account manager.
